name: Arcosa, Inc.
summary:
Arcosa (ACA) reported earnings of $0.51 per share on revenue of $571.70 million for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.13 per share on revenue of $654.45 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 292.31% while revenue fell 9.54% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $2.60 billion to $2.70 billion, excluding its barge business. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $2.54 billion to $2.67 billion, excluding its barge business, and the current consensus revenue estimate, which includes its barge business, is $3.02 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Arcosa, Inc. is a provider of infrastructure-related products and solutions with leading positions in construction, engineered structures, and transportation markets.
subject: Arcosa Beat Consensus Estimates
